description: Find upcoming VKU, first aid/Nothelfer or WAB courses by town, with teaching language, prices, all sessions, availability and existing booking links. list_course_locations gives coverage. WAB can use existing partner booking calendars; unknown/stale availability is explicitly labelled. Does not reserve or pay.

city.description: Swiss town name or canonical town slug, for example Zürich, zuerich, Zug, Luzern.

from_date.description: Local calendar date YYYY-MM-DD in Europe/Zurich.

language.description: Response and checkout language; does not filter the teaching language. Default de.

teaching_language.description: Only offers taught in this language. Omit to see all teaching languages.

name: search_courses
title: Find group courses
